queries.result: Uzbek-language first-party discovery found the official Bukhoro regional government page describing cadastral and cartographic data for Bukhoro viloyati, plus the National Geoportal and Cadastre Agency resources. No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-polygon response was obtained.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Uzbek discovery plus bounded official viewer/API inspection
sourceReview: The official Bukhoro regional government geospatial page states that cadastral and cartographic information for Bukhoro viloyati includes land-plot locations, boundaries, coordinates, and cadastral/topographic maps, and that such information is maintained through state cadastral systems. The national Cadastre Agency is the relevant state custodian. This is registry/cadastral and local-regional map evidence, but the inspection did not qualify a public anonymous parcel endpoint for Bukhara city.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: First-party search result identified the National Geoportal, showing coordinate and cadastral-number search controls and identifying the Cadastre Agency. The direct anonymous HTTPS GET timed out within 20 seconds; no JavaScript/configuration or parcel schema was obtained. This was treated as an unavailable route only, not as a zero hit or citywide absence.

Official State Urban Cadastre geoportal page was identified in first-party discovery as providing public data for unregistered users, but the bounded anonymous GET returned HTTP 403 with a short response. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, or TLS exception was attempted; no parcel schema or geometry was obtained.

Official Cadastre Agency Uzbek portal was identified and its published search result lists GIS, cadastral, geodesy, and open-data sections. The bounded anonymous GET timed out within 15 seconds. No viewer configuration or parcel response was obtained.

Official Bukhoro regional government geospatial-information page loaded. It explicitly describes cadastral and cartographic data for Bukhoro viloyati, including land-plot locations, boundaries, coordinates, and cadastral/topographic maps, and names state cadastral systems as the operating context. It is descriptive/procedural evidence only; it embeds no anonymous parcel feature service, native ID, schema, or geometry.

Official Cadastre Agency page loaded and identifies the agency's responsibilities for state cadastre maintenance, geodesy/cartography, and real-estate rights registration, with public services through state service centers and the unified interactive portal. It provides national custodian/procedure context, not parcel geometry.

The official Uzbek Cadastre Agency section was referenced during first-party discovery, but no separate bounded feature request was made because the inspected public material exposed no safe parcel endpoint. No geometry or identity was obtained.
